title: Mechanism-Based Pharmacokinetic/Pharmacodynamic Modeling of Aerosolized Colistin in a Mouse Lung Infection Model
locator: Abstract; Results / Population PK model; Methods / PK data; Simulations
quote: Clinical studies are warranted to validate and refine our MBM for aerosolized colistin.
summary: S-ADAPT model: two systemic plus two pulmonary PK compartments, linked to susceptible/resistant bacterial populations and sigmoid killing. Reuses 2017 PK data.
validation: Reported VPCs and PK/PD target checks; early ELF mismatch and weakly precise transfer estimate. Human simulations used existing human CMS PK, not animal-to-human PK prediction.
data_availability: Published figures / supplement; individual raw records not verified.
code_availability: Executable PK fitting code not verified.
